name: Swami Vivekananda Merit-cum-Means Scholarship
provider: Government of West Bengal
description: A premier state government scholarship providing financial assistance to meritorious students from economically weaker sections pursuing UG, PG, or professional courses in West Bengal.
documents: Mark sheet of the last qualifying examination
Income Certificate issued by Joint BDO or above
Domicile Certificate (Aadhaar Card, Voter Card, or residential certificate)
First page of Bank Passbook showing Account No. and IFSC Code
Admission Receipt of the current academic session
applicationProcess: Access the official SVMCM portal: https://svmcm.wb.gov.in/
Register as a new user by selecting the appropriate directorate (e.g., DPI, DTE).
Login with the generated credentials and complete the application profile.
Upload scanned copies of all required documents in PDF format.
Review the information, submit the online application, and print the confirmation page.
importantNotes: The income certificate must be from an officer not below the rank of Joint BDO.
Double application for multiple government scholarships will lead to rejection of both.
Minority students may apply from https://www.wbmdfcscholarship.org/

name: Oasis Post-Matric Scholarship
provider: Backward Classes Welfare Department, West Bengal
description: Financial support for SC, ST, and OBC category students pursuing post-matric courses to enable them to complete their higher education.
documents: Caste Certificate issued by a competent authority
Income Certificate from a gazetted officer
Mark sheet of the last qualifying examination
Residential proof (Aadhaar or Voter card)
Bank Account details copy
Fees book / Admission receipt
applicationProcess: Open the Oasis portal: https://oasis.gov.in/
Click on 'Student Registration' and choose your district.
Verify your Caste Certificate detail online.
Fill out the application form, save draft, and click final submit.
Submit the printed physical form copy along with documents to your respective college office.
importantNotes: The application must be verified and forwarded by the college administrative cell.
Ensure your bank account is linked with your Aadhaar number (Aadhaar Seeding).

name: Aikyashree Minority Scholarship
provider: West Bengal Minorities Development and Finance Corporation (WBMDFC)
description: A tailored scholarship program for students belonging to minority communities (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Parsi, Jain) in West Bengal.
documents: Self-declaration of Minority Community certificate
Income Certificate from a competent authority
Mark sheet of previous qualifying exam
Bank details proof (passbook/cancelled check)
Current session fees book
applicationProcess: Visit the WBMDFC Aikyashree portal: https://wbmdfc.org/
Register details, entering your course details and college identification.
Fill out the academic details and upload documents.
Submit online, print the hard copy, and submit it to your nodal officer.
importantNotes: Only students belonging to notified minority communities of West Bengal can apply.
Must have secured at least 50% marks in the previous examination.

name: West Bengal Chief Minister's Relief Fund (Nabanna)
provider: Government of West Bengal
description: Financial assistance from the Chief Minister's Relief Fund for meritorious students who have passed their last board or university exam and reside in West Bengal.
documents: Copy of Recommendation from MLA or MP
Self-declaration copy of family income countersigned by a Group-A Officer
Mark sheets of previous exams
Bank passbook front page front side
Self-declaration containing mobile number and signatures
Current semester fee structure/receipt
applicationProcess: Obtain the physical application form from Nabanna office or download the official format online.
Get MLA/MP recommendation signature on the application form.
Compile physical copies of all required credentials.
Submit the documents in-person to Nabanna Office (Kolkata) or mail them to the Joint Secretary, Chief Minister's Office.
importantNotes: Requires active Recommendation from an MLA or MP from West Bengal.
Usually given as a one-time grant of ₹10,000 per academic year.

name: HDFC Bank Parivartan's ECS Scholarship
provider: HDFC Bank Foundation
description: A private scholarship intended for meritorious students belonging to underprivileged sections of society, covering school, college, and professional degrees across India.
documents: Previous year academic mark sheet
Income proof (Salary slip, IT return, or local authority certificate)
Identity proof (Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Voter Card)
Admission letter or college receipt
Recent passport size photograph
Bank statement of the applicant or parent
applicationProcess: Access the Buddy4Study portal or the official HDFC page.
Navigate to the HDFC Parivartan ECS application link.
Complete registration, fill out details, and answer short eligibility questions.
Upload all supporting papers and submit online.
importantNotes: Priority is given to students facing family crises or sudden financial hardships.
Open to students across India.

name: L'Oréal India For Young Women in Science Scholarship
provider: L'Oréal India
description: An exclusive private scholarship aimed at encouraging young women to pursue careers in science, engineering, medicine, and other scientific fields in India.
documents: Aadhaar Card copy
Class 10 and 12 mark sheets
Income certificate issued by local self-government or SDM
Proof of admission in a science-related UG course
applicationProcess: Submit application on the official L'Oréal portal or partner channel (Buddy4Study).
Fill out personal, academic, and financial background details.
Submit a brief essay detailing career aspirations and interest in science.
Shortlisted candidates undergo a telephone interview followed by final selection.
importantNotes: Strictly for female candidates pursuing undergraduate degrees in science streams.
Must have obtained 85% or above in PCB/PCM in Class 12 board exams.

name: Kanyashree Prakalpa (K1, K2, K3)
provider: Department of Women Development and Social Welfare, Government of West Bengal
description: A conditional cash transfer scheme designed to improve the status and well-being of girl children in West Bengal by encouraging education, delaying early marriage, and providing financial aid through three tiers (K1 annual stipend, K2 one-time grant, and K3 postgraduate aid).

dates.periodText: Throughout the Academic Session / Rolling Applications

documents: Unmarried Certificate / Self-declaration confirming single status
Income Certificate issued by an appropriate authority (or disability/orphan certificate for income waiver)
Proof of Age (Birth Certificate, Madhyamik Admit Card, or official age proof)
Proof of Enrollment/Admission from school, college, or university
Bank Passbook first page showing Account Number, IFSC code, and beneficiary details
Undergraduate Mark Sheet (Mandatory for K3 applicants showing min. 45% marks)
applicationProcess: For K1 and K2: Obtain the official paper application form (Form K1/K2) from your school or college.
Fill out the form with personal, educational, and bank account details.
Attach all required supporting documents and submit the completed form to the institutional Nodal Officer/Headmaster.
The institution uploads the details to the official Kanyashree portal and generates a unique Application ID.
For K3: Register online on the official portal/SVMCM portal using your K2 ID, fill out course details, upload documents, and submit.
importantNotes: The applicant must be unmarried at the time of application for K1 and K2 grants.
Maximum family income ceiling of ₹1,20,000 per year is waived for girls with 40%+ disability, orphans, or residents of registered Child Care Institutions.
K3 applicants must have previously received the K2 grant and achieved at least 45% marks in their Undergraduate degree.

name: Bigyani Kanya Medha Britti (JBNSTS)
provider: Jagadis Bose National Science Talent Search (JBNSTS), Kolkata
description: A prestigious state-level scholarship initiative administered by JBNSTS and supported by the Government of West Bengal to identify, mentor, and financially aid meritorious female students pursuing education in science, engineering, and medicine.
documents: Scanned copy of Class 10 mark sheet (Junior level) or Class 12 mark sheet (Senior level)
Proof of current admission in Class 11 (Science) or 1st year Undergraduate program (Basic Science/Engineering/Medicine)
High-resolution recent passport-sized photograph
Scanned signature of the applicant
Domicile Certificate or proof of studying in a recognized institution in West Bengal
applicationProcess: Visit the official JBNSTS examination portal: https://jbnsts.ac.in/
Select the application link for 'Junior Bigyani Kanya Medha Britti' or 'Senior Bigyani Kanya Medha Britti'.
Fill in the online application form with personal, contact, and academic details.
Upload the required documents (photograph, signature, mark sheet, and admission proof).
Pay the non-refundable examination fee (₹100 for Junior / ₹200 for Senior) online and submit the application.
importantNotes: Selection is conducted through a written Talent Search Examination followed by an interview and scientific creativity assessment.
Junior level candidates must have selected at least three science subjects (Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology, Statistics, Computer Science) in Class 11.
In addition to monthly stipends and annual book grants, scholars receive exposure to scientific workshops, seminars, and research projects.

name: JBNSTS Senior Scholarship Scheme
provider: Jagadis Bose National Science Talent Search (JBNSTS), Kolkata
description: A flagship state-level scholarship scheme for meritorious students who have passed Higher Secondary exams and are pursuing undergraduate degree courses in Basic Science, Engineering, or Medicine in West Bengal.

financial.text: ₹4,000 / month + ₹5,000 / year book grant

documents: Scanned copy of Class 10 mark sheet
Scanned copy of Class 12 mark sheet
Proof of admission in 1st year Undergraduate course (Basic Science Hons / Engineering / Medicine) in West Bengal
High-resolution recent passport-sized photograph
Scanned signature of the applicant
applicationProcess: Visit the official JBNSTS examination portal: https://jbnsts.ac.in/
Select the application link for 'Senior Talent Search Test (STST)'.
Complete the registration form with personal details, academic history, and enrollment credentials.
Upload scanned copies of required mark sheets, admission proof, photo, and signature.
Pay the non-refundable examination fee (₹200) online and submit the application.
importantNotes: Students enrolled in general graduation (pass courses), diploma programs, or B.Sc Nursing are strictly not eligible.
Selection involves a three-phase evaluation: Written Examination, Personal Interview, and Scientific Creativity Test.
Scholars are directly eligible to participate in scientific seminars, workshops, and the DST-INSPIRE programme.

name: GP Birla Scholarship
provider: GP Birla Educational Foundation
description: A merit-cum-means private scholarship program supporting academically exceptional yet economically underprivileged students from West Bengal to pursue undergraduate degrees at recognized Indian universities.

financial.text: Up to ₹60,000 / year + one-time book grant of ₹7,000

documents: Scanned copy of Class 12 mark sheet
Proof of admission in 1st year Undergraduate course (Admission fee receipt or institutional letter)
Father's and/or Mother's Annual Family Income Certificate (issued by competent authority)
Applicant's Recent Passport-sized photograph (under 100 KB)
Domicile Certificate of West Bengal or Jharkhand
applicationProcess: Navigate to the official portal: https://gpbirlaedufoundation.com/
Click on 'Apply Online' for the current academic session.
Fill in personal, contact, family income, Class 12 academic results, and UG course admission details.
Upload photograph, income certificate (PDF), and mark sheets.
Submit the online application form before the cutoff date and save the generated Applicant Number.
importantNotes: Minimum required marks: 85% for WBCHSE board or 90% for ISC/CBSE boards in Class 12.
Annual family income ceiling has been updated to ₹8,00,000 per annum.
Shortlisted candidates are selected based on academic merit, financial need, and an interview conducted by Expert Committee Trustees.

name: West Bengal Hindi Scholarship Scheme
provider: Department of Higher Education, Government of West Bengal
description: A state government scholarship scheme aimed at encouraging students from non-Hindi speaking states like West Bengal to study Hindi language by providing financial assistance to those pursuing Hindi as a subject in Higher Secondary, Undergraduate, or Postgraduate courses.
documents: Attested mark sheet of the last qualifying examination (Madhyamik, Higher Secondary, or UG)
Proof of admission in the current course with Hindi as one of the combination/main subjects
Domicile Certificate of West Bengal
Mother Tongue declaration certificate (confirming non-Hindi native status)
First page of Bank Passbook displaying Account Number and IFSC Code
applicationProcess: Obtain the official application form from the Higher Education Department office (Bikash Bhavan) or download it from the portal.
Fill in personal, academic, and institution details accurately.
Attach attested copies of qualifying mark sheets, mother tongue proof, and admission receipts.
Get the application form verified and attested by the Head of the Institution (Principal/Headmaster).
Submit the completed hard copy form to the Scholarship Section, Education Directorate, Bikash Bhavan, Salt Lake, Kolkata.
importantNotes: The applicant's mother tongue must NOT be Hindi (specifically designed for non-Hindi speaking domiciles).
Students pursuing studies through correspondence/distance education or private mode are not eligible.
Candidates must have Hindi as one of the full-time subjects in their current course of study.

name: Indian Oil Sports Scholarship
provider: Indian Oil Corporation Limited (IOCL)
description: A specialized scholarship initiative by Indian Oil Corporation Limited aimed at nurturing young, talented sportspersons across various recognized sports disciplines by providing monthly financial support to help cover training, equipment, and tournament expenses.

financial.text: ₹12,000 - ₹16,000 / month (based on Elite or Scholar category)

documents: Proof of Age / Birth Certificate or Class 10 Board Certificate
Sports Performance & Certificate of Merit (National / International representation)
Certificate from National Sports Federation (NSF) or State Sports Association
Recent passport-sized photograph of the athlete
Government-issued Photo ID Proof (Aadhaar Card, Passport, or School ID)
First page of Bank Passbook showing Account Number and IFSC Code
applicationProcess: Visit the official IOCL Sports portal: https://iocl.com/.
Navigate to the 'Indian Oil Sports Scholarship' application section.
Register by providing basic contact details, age proof, and chosen sports discipline.
Fill out the application form with detailed tournament participation records and achievements.
Upload scanned copies of sports certificates, age proof, and bank details, then submit the form.
importantNotes: Applicants must be between 13 and 19 years of age at the time of application.
Scholarships are awarded across two categories: 'Elite Sportspersons' and 'Scholars'.
Covers approved disciplines such as Athletics, Badminton, Chess, Cricket, Table Tennis, Swimming, Hockey, and Tennis.
Athletes representing the country at international or national levels receive priority selection.

name: Post-Matric Scholarships Scheme for Minorities
provider: Ministry of Minority Affairs, Government of India (via National Scholarship Portal)
description: A central sector scheme providing financial assistance to meritorious students belonging to economically weaker sections of notified minority communities to pursue post-matriculation or higher education from Class 11 up to Ph.D. level in recognized institutions across India.

financial.text: ₹3,000 - ₹10,000 / year (includes admission, tuition fee & maintenance allowance)

documents: Mark sheet of the last qualifying examination (securing minimum 50% marks)
Self-declaration / Minority Community Certificate
Income Certificate issued by a designated state authority
Proof of admission / Current fee receipt from the institution
First page of Bank Passbook displaying Account Number, IFSC, and applicant photo
Domicile Certificate issued by competent government authority
applicationProcess: Visit the official National Scholarship Portal (NSP): https://scholarships.gov.in/
Register for OTR (One-Time Registration) using mobile number and Aadhaar verification.
Log in to the student dashboard and fill out the detailed application form.
Select 'Post-Matric Scholarships Scheme for Minorities' under the Ministry of Minority Affairs section.
Upload scanned copies of required documents, submit online, and verify status via institute node.
importantNotes: Exclusively applicable to students belonging to 6 notified minority communities: Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, and Parsi.
30% of the overall scheme quota is reserved for girl students.
Students cannot hold more than one government scholarship simultaneously for the same course of study.

name: Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarship
provider: Reliance Foundation
description: A prestigious pan-India scholarship initiative supporting meritorious undergraduate students from all academic streams, enabling them to complete their degree programs with financial security, leadership training, and network access.

financial.text: Up to ₹2,00,000 spread over the duration of the degree course

documents: Class 12 board mark sheet showing minimum 60% aggregate
Proof of 1st-year enrollment in a full-time undergraduate degree course (Admission Slip / Identity Card)
Annual Family Income Certificate (Issued by competent authority or Salary Slips/ITR)
Recent passport-sized photograph
Government-issued Photo ID Proof (Aadhaar, Voter ID, Passport)
applicationProcess: Visit the official portal: https://www.scholarships.reliancefoundation.org/
Complete the eligibility questionnaire to verify status.
Fill out the online application form with personal, academic, and income details.
Upload mandatory documents in PDF/JPEG format.
Mandatory online Aptitude Test must be taken within specified dates to complete selection.
importantNotes: Open to students enrolled in the 1st year of any full-time undergraduate degree program.
Family income up to ₹15 Lakhs per annum is eligible, with preference given to applicants with income under ₹2.5 Lakhs.
Selection involves academic performance, income evaluation, and a compulsory 60-minute online aptitude test.

name: Tata Capital Pankh Scholarship Scheme
provider: Tata Capital Limited (CSR Initiative)
description: A CSR initiative by Tata Capital providing financial coverage of up to 80% of tuition fees to meritorious and economically vulnerable students pursuing school, diploma, general graduation, or professional degree programs.

financial.text: Up to 80% of tuition fees or ₹10,000 - ₹1,00,000 / year (varies by course level)

documents: Mark sheet of the previous academic class (minimum 60% aggregate required)
Government-issued identity proof (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, Driving License)
Current year admission proof (Fee Receipt, Admission Letter, College ID card)
Proof of family income (Income certificate, Form 16A, BPL card, Salary slip)
Bank account details of the applicant (or joint account with parent for minors)
applicationProcess: Go to the designated application page on Buddy4Study portal.
Log in with registered account credentials or create a new user profile.
Fill out personal information, academic details, and course choices.
Upload required supporting documents clear in PDF or JPG formats.
Accept terms and conditions and submit the online application.
importantNotes: Minimum required marks: 60% for general graduation/diploma courses, up to 80% for specialized professional courses.
Family annual income must not exceed ₹2,50,000 from all combined sources.
Children of employees of Tata Capital and Buddy4Study are strictly ineligible.

name: Sitaram Jindal Foundation Scholarship
provider: Sitaram Jindal Foundation
description: A long-standing merit-cum-means private scholarship program that offers monthly stipend support to underprivileged Indian students pursuing education from Class 11 up to Post-Graduation, including professional and medical degrees.

financial.text: ₹500 - ₹3,200 / month + additional hostel allowance (₹1,000 - ₹1,200/month)

dates.periodText: Open Round the Year / Rolling Basis

documents: Attested copy of Mark Sheet of the last qualifying examination
Income Certificate issued by competent authority (up to ₹2.5L for general, ₹4L for salaried)
Certificate of Admission/Fee receipt from current institution
Certificate from Warden/Head of Institution (for hostellers receiving hostel grant)
Physical Disability Certificate (if applicable for mark relaxations)
applicationProcess: Download the prescribed application form Annexure-I from https://www.sitaramjindalfoundation.org/
Fill in personal, academic, family background, and course information in physical form.
Attach required attested documents and obtain Principal/Head of Institution verification signature and stamp.
Send the physical application form via speed post/courier to the foundation office in Bengaluru or apply online via their portal.
Track status online using application ID.
importantNotes: Applications are accepted year-round without a fixed cutoff date.
Female applicants, physically challenged students, and wards of ex-servicemen receive relaxed percentage requirements.
Final year students who have already completed course duration are ineligible to apply.

name: Kotak Kanya Scholarship
provider: Kotak Education Foundation & Kotak Mahindra Group
description: A focused corporate social initiative providing financial grants to high-achieving female students from low-income families to complete professional undergraduate graduation degrees at recognized Indian institutes.

financial.text: Up to ₹1,50,000 / year (covers tuition fees, hostel, books, laptop, & academic expense)

documents: Class 12 board examination mark sheet showing 75% or higher
Proof of 1st-year admission in a professional degree course in a recognized institute (NAAC/NIRF)
Annual Family Income Certificate issued by Sub-Divisional Magistrate / Tehsildar / Gazetted Officer
Fee receipt / Fee structure document issued by the college or university
Aadhaar Card of student
Passbook copy or cancelled cheque showing beneficiary bank details
applicationProcess: Access the Kotak Kanya Scholarship application link on Buddy4Study / Kotak portal.
Register using active mobile number and email ID.
Fill out educational details, family background, and income details.
Upload clean scans of all required documents (Class 12 mark sheet, income certificate, admission proof).
Submit application form and participate in telephonic/video interview if shortlisted.
importantNotes: Exclusively restricted to meritorious female students who have secured admission in 1st year professional degree programs.
Annual family income must be ₹6,00,000 or less.
Children of employees of Kotak Mahindra Group and Kotak Education Foundation are strictly excluded.

name: Priyamvada Birla Scholarship
provider: Madhav Prasad Priyamvada Birla Apex Charitable Trust & South Point Education Society
description: A merit-cum-means private scholarship program initiated by the M.P. Birla Group to provide financial assistance to deserving, economically underprivileged students pursuing 1st-year undergraduate degree courses in West Bengal.

financial.text: Up to ₹24,000 / year (towards course fees and academic maintenance)

documents: Attested copy of Class 12 board examination mark sheet (WBCHSE / CBSE / ISC)
Proof of admission in 1st year Undergraduate course in a college/university in West Bengal
Family Income Certificate issued by competent authority (Competent Gazetted Officer / BDO / Municipal Commissioner)
Copy of applicant's Aadhaar Card or Residential Domicile Certificate
First page of applicant's Bank Passbook displaying Account Number and IFSC Code
applicationProcess: Visit the designated application portal on the South Point Education Society website.
Register by entering basic personal details, Class 12 marks, and current college enrollment details.
Upload scanned copies of qualifying mark sheet, family income proof, and admission fee receipt.
Submit the online form and take a printout of the confirmation receipt for record-keeping.
Shortlisted candidates undergo verification by the Apex Charitable Trust selection committee.
importantNotes: Restricted strictly to 1st-year undergraduate college students studying within West Bengal.
Annual family income must not exceed ₹1,00,000 per annum from all sources.
The scholarship is granted initially for one year and is renewable annually subject to satisfactory academic evaluation.

name: FAEA Scholarship
provider: Foundation for Academic Excellence and Access (FAEA)
description: A pan-India private scholarship initiative offering comprehensive financial coverage for socially and economically disadvantaged students to pursue undergraduate degree programs in any discipline across recognized Indian institutions.

financial.text: Full funding covering tuition fees, maintenance allowance, hostel charges, books, travel, and incidental expenses

documents: Class 12 examination mark sheet or provisional pass certificate
Proof of admission / Enrollment certificate in a full-time 1st-year undergraduate course
Caste / Category Certificate (mandatory for SC/ST/OBC/Differently-Abled candidates)
Income Certificate / BPL Card confirming socially and economically weaker background
Government-issued identity proof (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, or Passport)
applicationProcess: Access the online portal at https://www.faeaindia.org/ and navigate to 'Fresh Registration'.
Fill in personal, contact, Class 12 board marks, chosen discipline, and referee details.
Submit the application online to generate a 9-digit Confirmation Code (no initial document uploads required).
Shortlisted candidates are called for regional interview rounds held in major metro cities.
Present original academic, category, and income certificates during the personal interview for final selection.
importantNotes: Special preference and allocation are given to SC, ST, OBC, BPL, and minority candidates.
Covers up to 3 to 5 years depending on the duration of the undergraduate program.
Tuition fees and hostel charges are paid directly to the institution, while allowances are credited to the student's bank account.

name: Reliance Foundation Scholarships
provider: Reliance Foundation
description: A national scholarship program offering merit-cum-means financial grants and capacity-building support to 1st-year undergraduate students across all streams and postgraduate students in specialized STEM fields.

financial.text: Up to ₹2,00,000 (UG) or ₹6,00,000 (PG) over the course duration

documents: Class 12 board examination mark sheet showing minimum 60% aggregate (for UG)
Undergraduate degree transcripts and GATE score card (for PG applicants)
Proof of enrollment in 1st year full-time UG/PG degree program (College ID / Fee Receipt)
Annual household income certificate / ITR / salary slip (income under ₹15 Lakhs)
Government-issued Photo ID (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, or Passport)
applicationProcess: Visit https://www.scholarships.reliancefoundation.org/ and select UG or PG program portal.
Complete the initial eligibility check and register your profile.
Fill out the comprehensive online application including academic achievements and personal essay.
Complete the mandatory 60-minute online Aptitude Test evaluating verbal, numerical, and logical reasoning.
Final selection is declared based on aptitude test score, academic history, and household income level.
importantNotes: Supports 5,000 undergraduate and 100 post-graduate scholars across India every year.
A household income preference is given to families with annual income under ₹2.5 Lakhs.
Selected scholars gain access to leadership development sessions, networking opportunities, and mentorship workshops.

name: Raman Kant Munjal Scholarship
provider: Raman Kant Munjal Foundation (in association with Hero FinCorp)
description: A prestigious merit-cum-means scholarship aimed at helping meritorious 1st-year undergraduate students pursuing finance, management, commerce, and economics degree courses across recognized colleges in India.

financial.text: ₹40,000 to ₹5,50,000 / year (renewable for up to 3 years based on course fees)

documents: Class 10 and Class 12 mark sheets showing minimum 80% aggregate
Proof of admission / College Acceptance Letter / Bonafide Certificate
College fee receipt and fee structure details
Annual Family Income Certificate or Salary Certificate / ITR
Applicant's Photo ID proof (Aadhaar Card or Voter ID)
First page of Bank Passbook displaying Account Number and IFSC Code
applicationProcess: Visit the official application portal on Buddy4Study / RKM Foundation website.
Register using an active email address and mobile number.
Fill in personal background, Class 10/12 board marks, and undergraduate enrollment details.
Upload clean scans of all required mark sheets, income certificate, and fee receipts.
Complete the short essay prompt / personal statement and submit the form.
Shortlisted candidates undergo a career assessment test followed by telephonic and final interviews.
importantNotes: Applicants must be currently enrolled in the 1st year of eligible management, commerce, or economics degree courses.
Minimum qualifying percentage is 80% in both Class 10 and Class 12 board examinations (70% for PwD candidates).
Annual family income ceiling is fixed at ₹6,00,000 per annum.

name: IndusInd Bank Merit Scholarship (IndusInd Foundation)
provider: IndusInd Foundation (Hinduja Group)
description: A long-running philanthropic scholarship scheme aimed at financially assisting meritorious high school graduates pursuing full-time undergraduate (Bachelor's) degree programs in Science, Arts, Commerce, Engineering, Medical, and Professional fields.

financial.text: ₹600 - ₹2,200 / month (credited directly to student's bank account)

documents: Attested copy of Higher Secondary (Class 12) Board Examination Scorecard
Proof of admission / Official Fee Receipt for 1st-year Bachelor's degree course
Family Income Proof (ITR copy, Salary Slips, or Government Income Certificate)
Student's Bank Details (Cancelled Cheque or Passbook first page)
Handwritten Career Plan document by the student
Copy of Photo ID Proof (Aadhaar Card / PAN Card)
Latest family photograph
applicationProcess: Download the prescribed application form from the official website: https://www.theindusindfoundation.org/
Fill out the physical form completely with personal details, academic history, and financial background.
Attach all mandatory attested documents, bank details, and the handwritten career plan.
Obtain institutional attestation/stamp from the Principal/Head of Department.
Send the completed hard copy application packet via registered post/courier to the IndusInd Foundation office in Mumbai.
importantNotes: Strictly restricted to students entering 1st year of full-time undergraduate degree courses after clearing HSC/Class 12.
Requires a minimum aggregate of 85% in Class 12 board examinations.
Applications are accepted via physical postal submission only; digital or email submissions are not accepted.
